integrity: Self-contained covariance integration and analytic global optimizer classification; symbolic and high-precision quadrature reproductions, with no claim of independent scientific validation.
scientific_limitations: One uniform-average sensor of fixed strictly interior width on a standard Brownian bridge.
Independent positive-variance observation noise for the average; no general prior, variable-width or multiple-sensor theorem.
The publication-priority comparison is qualified by unavailable dissertation full text and unindexed equivalents.
title: A discontinuous center-to-boundary transition for noisy Brownian-bridge window averages
